visualReview.notes: Galleria Borghese complete mapped connected villa exterior: pale plaster and limestone trim, five genuinely open round-arch loggia bays with recessed gates, raised terrace and paired outward-descending entrance flights, recessed central three-storey block, lower side wings, broad rear range and two tall square rear towers under terracotta hip roofs. Repeated tall windows, substantial cornices, simplified niches/medallions and balustrades convey the photographed identity. Neighboring park structures remain independent; no copied sculpture, inscriptions, art collections or interiors. Actually inspected 52 current source/shared/medium-fi/native frames. Five real curved arcade bays have closed soffits/floor and gates 2.13m behind the front; paired 10-tread flights have closed bases and continuous sloping handrails. Taller central block, broad rear range and twin towers carry separate hip roofs. Simplified original niche figures/oval medallions, window hoods and dentils are nearby details, not copied sculpture.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Six roles share six existing 256px graphs: stucco, stone_limestone, tile_ceramic, storefront, metal_painted and wood_plain. Canonical metric UVs, linear tints and graph means for skyline. Six nearby draws/five district/one skyline. No embedded images, private atlas or new graph. Separate POSITION/NORMAL streams and equal CPU/GPU geometry accounting. Each used graph reads once and unload disposes all model geometry. Flat shared/synthetic ground partly buries sloped stair bases and can reveal small cutout patches; the unchanged native ground establishes site contact.

mediumFiReview.notes: Four authored LODs 778 / 1892 / 4560 / 6078 triangles; skyline+district geometry 245924 bytes, closeup 564376 bytes. Six GLBs zero Khronos errors/warnings; 443 actual mesh/contact probes; 3 PMTiles13/14/15 cases with one detailed owned parent. 52 current inspected frames. Skyline keeps complete roof/tower envelope, five real arcade bays and coarse paired stair flights; closeup adds window bars, continuous handrails, balusters and original geometric ornament. 552 resident/711 wider independent buildings, original 201x201/6m terrain/roads and 15157.697m² water retained. Failure restores all 553 resident originals; every LOD/failure/unload restores ground/water and releases geometry. Flat style contexts can partly bury stairs, crop outer wings or clip the nearest tower in the ornament detail; full turntables and native whole/front/rear views cover the complete envelope.
